messages.subject: Redefinition of basic operators in src/stan/agrad/agrad_thread_safe.hpp?
parts:
Not sure what's going on, but we've got a lot of redefinitions. I stumbled on it when looking at output from doxygen.

I don't see it being included anywhere from Stan. It looks like we've out-grown it. Should it be removed?



Daniel

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Redefinition of basic operators in src/stan/agrad/agrad_thread_safe.hpp?
parts:
Yes, the idea was that you'd include either agrad or agrad_thread_safe.

Since we haven't kept the tread safe version up to date, I just got
rid of it in the ODE branch where I updated autodiff to use a stack
so as to allow local reverse mode for ODE solving.

So once the ODE branch is merged, this problem will go away.

- Bob
